title: pay — Spring Modulith 결제 시스템
titleEn: pay — A Payment System on Spring Modulith
description: 실 서비스 운영을 상정한 결제 백엔드. 정상 경로보다 실패·정합성 처리에 무게를 뒀다 — 타임아웃·중복·장애를 상태로 보존하고 복구 배치로 확정한다. 복식부기 원장·정산/대사·체크아웃 사가(PG 콜을 트랜잭션 밖으로)·멀티PG·구독·선불 월렛·회원·분쟁/차지백까지. 실 MySQL 라이브 검증과 자가 감사로 자금 손실 버그를 잡아가며 다졌다.
descriptionEn: A payment backend built for real-world operation — weighted toward failure and consistency handling over the happy path. Timeouts, duplicates, and faults are preserved as state and reconciled by recovery batches. Double-entry ledger, settlement/reconciliation, a checkout saga (PG call outside the transaction), multi-PG routing, subscriptions, prepaid wallet, membership, and disputes/chargebacks — hardened through live MySQL verification and self-audits that caught money-loss bugs.
